value.rationale: Zero-envy feasibility in random proportional apportionment is a motivated question. The theorem proves generic impossibility for exactly two nontrivial quota-floor groups and an explicit sharp quantitative minimum and unique policy in the first balanced multi-floor cell. It explains why a published zero-envy example lies on a thin compatibility set and supplies a constant-time rule beyond numerical LP output.
